faithfulness.definition: mean faithfulness (1-5) over single_doc + multi_doc: all claims supported by retrieved context

completeness.definition: mean completeness (1-5) over single_doc + multi_doc: full use of the retrieved context, incl. supported synthesis

hallucination_rate.definition: % of near_miss + out_of_scope judged 'hallucinated' (answered from outside knowledge); 'full_decline' and 'partial_grounded' are both correct

source_attribution.definition: % of all questions where correctly_cited_sources was true
